policy: All Rust and Clippy warnings are denied except the exact entries below.

lints.name: result_large_err
lints.rationale: VibexError carries bounded structured diagnostics across every service boundary; changing its representation requires a coordinated API and performance review.
lints.removalGate: Measure error-path size and latency before changing the VibexError representation.

lints.name: derivable_impls
lints.rationale: Explicit defaults are retained where they make domain initialization behavior visible.
lints.removalGate: Remove explicit defaults in a dedicated no-behavior-change cleanup.

lints.name: single_match
lints.rationale: The affected branches intentionally preserve explicit fall-through behavior in shared runtime orchestration.
lints.removalGate: Replace each occurrence when its surrounding control flow is simplified.

lints.name: too_many_arguments
lints.rationale: Several orchestration entry points coordinate distinct runtime resources whose ownership is clearer as explicit parameters.
lints.removalGate: Replace affected signatures with owned request types when that reduces call-site complexity.

lints.name: large_enum_variant
lints.rationale: Provider-neutral event payload layout is a cross-client protocol concern and requires compatibility evidence before representation changes.
lints.removalGate: Measure and revise payload layout with protocol compatibility evidence.

lints.name: needless_return
lints.rationale: The affected returns are style-only exceptions with no runtime impact.
lints.removalGate: Remove in a dedicated formatting and style cleanup.

lints.name: items_after_test_module
lints.rationale: A few large modules keep private helpers next to the test-only behavior they support.
lints.removalGate: Split affected modules or move their test modules during focused module cleanup.
